meta.title: JobPilot Demo
meta.description: AI career copilot — live product walkthrough

scenes.name: Home
scenes.narration_text: JobPilot. Your AI career copilot. Land your next role without the grind.

scenes.name: Login
scenes.narration_text: One click. Instant access. Magic link login — no passwords to remember or lose.

scenes.name: Onboarding
scenes.narration_text: Upload one resume and AI fills your entire profile instantly. Summary, skills, experience — done.

scenes.name: Matches
scenes.narration_text: Every job is scored against your unique profile. Zero to one hundred — so you know exactly where to focus.

scenes.name: Applications
scenes.narration_text: Tailor your resume and cover letter with AI. Review before you apply. Track everything on a Kanban board from discovery to offer.

scenes.name: Profile
scenes.narration_text: Your skills, experience, and preferences — all managed in one place. Always up to date.

scenes.name: Usage
scenes.narration_text: A generous free tier with no credit card needed. Upgrade when you outgrow it.

scenes.name: CTA
scenes.narration_text: Stop grinding. Start landing. Try JobPilot today.
